installCommand: bash -c 'set -e; if [ ! -d "$HOME/flutter" ]; then git clone --depth 1 -b 3.47.6 https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git "$HOME/flutter"; fi; export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"; flutter config --no-analytics; flutter --version'
buildCommand: bash -c 'set -e; export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"; flutter pub get && flutter build web --release'
